title: Add human decision inbox and interrupt resume workflow
measurement_note: Timing was reconstructed during a long governance update, so phase durations are approximate.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: External HITL and workflow sources were checked before local planning.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap
phases.bottleneck_notes: Memory bootstrap ran before edits and confirmed hot anchors.

phases.label: Requirements and spec
phases.bottleneck_notes: Included REQ-WS-048, change/review records, and spec artifacts.

phases.label: Inbox, workflow, prompt, and config updates
phases.bottleneck_notes: Main cost was synchronizing the new inbox rule across ops, configs, instructions, notification settings, memory bootstrap, and routing docs.

phases.label: History and evaluation records
phases.bottleneck_notes: Included web records, research notes, plan, request trace, work summary, grounding, evaluator input, and timing.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Reserved for JSON, config contract, memory, docs, naming, structure, workspace index, task board, grounding, evaluator, work timer, and diff checks.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.bottleneck_notes: Commit and push expected to be short unless remote rejects.

bottleneck_analysis.interpretation: The slowest part is keeping a durable governance rule discoverable across many repository surfaces.
improvement_candidates: Create a small deterministic inbox CLI if this workflow is used repeatedly.
Expose open human decisions in workspace-monitor so humans can answer from a dashboard.
